{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tribal Relief Fund''' was a charitable fund organized by [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] and his [[Black Dust Industries]]. The money funnelled into the fund helped to pay for extra food, shelter, and medical care for the various tribes on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], as well as land preservation.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
